commitMessage: Fixed bug 324719: NPE in context help in Java Editor when CU not on build path
dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-for-specific-method-argument>
<!description: Adds a null check for an argument before calling ActionUtil.isOnBuildPath to prevent NullPointerException when the argument is potentially null. This is a common pattern for methods that do not handle null arguments gracefully.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: null-safety, npe>

org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.util.ActionUtil.isOnBuildPath($input) :: isNullable($input)
=> $input != null && org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.util.ActionUtil.isOnBuildPath($input)
;;
